summary: The prepared main checkout already contains the merged PR #34167 correction for the SM90a CUDA 13.1+ top-k v2 address-space mislowering that can corrupt indices before fp8_paged_mqa_logits. No additional code change was justified. Focused gfx950 boundary tests passed, but ROCm compiles out the implicated CUDA cluster/DSMEM branch.

tests.what_was_measured: Collected the current 278-case top-k v2 regression suite and confirmed explicit dispatch/boundary coverage is present.
Five gfx950 GPU cases passed against the independent torch.topk numerical reference, including both sides of the 65536 boundary and long-context lengths through 131072.

tests.command: git fetch --no-tags https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git accc51c6dbe5ad59110b0fc405a979be9b61fd68; inspect current TopKCluster scatter implementation
tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed the current source retains PR #34167's separate CTA-local and DSMEM scatter branches and its compiler-mislowering guard comment.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 ran five numerical top-k boundary tests; reports/j-3d33447f4aba/raw/gfx950_topk_boundaries.log records 5 passed.

remaining_limitations: The assigned gfx950 ROCm device does not execute the CUDA-only TopKCluster distributed-shared-memory branch implicated by the report.
No H100/H200, CUDA 13.1+ compiler/runtime, compute-sanitizer, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights, or TP=8 topology was available.

The original 80K-130K serving failure was not reproduced locally; the result relies on current-source inspection, merged PR #34167's issue-specific H200 before/after evidence, and portable gfx950 boundary checks.
No full-model, HTTP-serving, semantic-accuracy, or distributed-workload claim is made.
